_note: GTM-1a — THE PRICES, IN ONE FILE THAT BOTH SIDES READ NATIVELY. The server reads it through pricing.js (CommonJS, which adds the lookups and the things a browser must never see); the client imports THIS FILE directly, because Vite parses JSON natively and a CommonJS module at the repo root it does not. That was not a style choice: shared/pricing.js as a CJS re-export failed the client build with 'default is not exported by ../pricing.js' — Rollup's CommonJS transform only covers node_modules. Numbers live here and nowhere else.
